verdict.rationale: Superpowers turns the host coding agent into a delegate. After you approve a plan, it dispatches each engineering task to subagents, reviews their work with a code-reviewer agent, and can run autonomously for hours. Ambiguities get recorded rulings, and only destructive actions stop for a human. A community user corroborates the brainstorm → plan → subagent-implement workflow. The main caveat is that the AI is not native to Superpowers: it is a skills plugin that rides on an external harness (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.). Missing for 10: a self-contained assistant that does not depend on a separately installed agent harness, and independent hands-on evidence of end-to-end delegated task completion beyond anecdotes.
